                <h1 class="entry-title">Maharashtra: Sugarcane farmers continue highway blockade at Kini for second day; insist on Rs 4,500 first instalment</h1>

                

                <div class="td-module-meta-info">
                    <div class="td-post-author-name"><div class="td-author-by">By</div> <a href="https://www.chinimandi.com/author/vivek-waghmode/">Vivek Waghmode</a><div class="td-author-line"> - </div> </div>                    <span class="td-post-date"><time class="entry-date updated td-module-date" datetime="2026-11-04T12:36:35+05:30">November 4, 2026</time></span>                                                        </div>

            </header>


        </div>

        

        <div class="td-post-content tagdiv-type">
            <div class="td-featured-image-rec">

            <div class="td-post-featured-image"><a href="https://www.chinimandi.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Protest-01.jpeg" data-caption="" class="td-modal-image"><img width="364" height="205" class="entry-thumb td-animation-stack-type0-2" src="https://www.chinimandi.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Protest-01.jpeg" srcset="https://www.chinimandi.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Protest-01.jpeg 364w, https://www.chinimandi.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Protest-01-300x169.jpeg 300w, https://www.chinimandi.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Protest-01-150x84.jpeg 150w" sizes="(max-width: 364px) 100vw, 364px" alt="" title="Protest 01"></a></div>            </div>

            <p>Kolhapur: The indefinite highway blockade launched by the Swabhimani Shetkari Sanghatana at Kini Toll Plaza, demanding a first instalment of Rs 4,500 per tonne for sugarcane, continued for a second day on Wednesday, with no breakthrough reported even after 24 hours of protest. Traffic on the Pune-Bengaluru National Highway remained severely disrupted as farmers refused to vacate the protest site.</p>
<p>The agitation began on Tuesday afternoon under the leadership of former MP Raju Shetti, with hundreds of sugarcane growers from surrounding areas joining the protest. Farmers spent the night on the highway and continued their agitation on Wednesday. Arrangements were made at the protest site to provide tea, breakfast and other food to the participants.</p><div class="td-a-rec td-a-rec-id-content_inline  tdi_43 td_block_template_1">

<p><strong>Farmers refuse to withdraw agitation</strong></p>
<p>The protesting farmers have maintained that they will not call off the agitation under any circumstances until their demand for a first instalment of Rs 4,500 per tonne is accepted. They have decided to continue the highway blockade until a settlement is reached.</p>
<p>Highway police have arranged traffic diversions at several locations between Karad and Kagal and appealed to commuters to use alternative routes. The diversions have been put in place at Karad and Peth Naka towards Pune, and at Sangli Phata, Toap, Wathar, Kagal and Uchgaon Phata towards Kolhapur.</p>
<p>Meanwhile, according to sources Kolhapur District Collector Vijay Rathod was likely to intervene to resolve the deadlock. He is learnt to have sought a proposal from sugar mills.</p>
<p>The proposed payment structure is yet to result in a resolution, while farmers continue to insist on their demand for Rs 4,500 per tonne as the first instalment.</p>
